prior_summary: Track absolute Cartesian targets in a fresh articulated drawer frame so approach, pull, release and retreat transform with a supplied reachable drawer displacement.
applicable_conditions: Prefer with a reliable current drawer origin/orientation and drawer_position, especially for a reachable cabinet-anchor displacement or an entry after partial opening. TCP must be free/high or plausibly near the drawer front.
termination_guidance: Switch after drawer_position is safely above 0.26 m and stable. The nominal robust handoff also observes released front contact, closed fingers around red, and red/TCP upward co-motion; these cues do not alter task success.
limitations: Does not prove contact or recover a missed handle. Large shifts can violate reachability/collision constraints. Independent red displacement, bad drawer calibration, alternative drawer orientation dynamics, failed pulls and drops are outside demonstrated support.
